say:1:1013114001:1.text: This treasure box is worth a bag of rubies, at least!
say:1:1013114001:1.source_cn: 这箱至宝珍玩，起码要一袋红宝石来换！

choice_prompt:2:1013114001.text: This treasure box is worth a bag of rubies, at least!
choice_prompt:2:1013114001.source_cn: 这箱至宝珍玩，起码要一袋红宝石来换！

say:3:1013114002:1.text: Ah-ah! There's no bargaining here in our little trade. It's a fair deal or no deal.
say:3:1013114002:1.source_cn: 小本生意，恕不还价。公平交易，愿打愿挨。

say:5:1013114003:0.text: Even the magister's negotiating skills couldn't sway this merchant. Syndicate merchants are so deceitful!
say:5:1013114003:0.source_cn: 主人要砍的价钱居然砍不下来！黑金商会、黑心奸商！
say:5:1013114003:0.male: Even the magister's negotiating skills couldn't sway this merchant. Syndicate merchants are so deceitful!
say:5:1013114003:0.female: Even the magister's negotiating skills couldn't sway this merchant. Syndicate merchants are so deceitful!

say:7:1013114006:1.text: Hey, calm down. <style="stress"><player_name></style>, what's going on?
say:7:1013114006:1.male: Hey, calm down. <style="stress"><player_name></style>, what's going on?
say:7:1013114006:1.female: Hey, calm down. <style="stress"><player_name></style>, what's going on?

say:8:1013114007:1.text: Haggling over this box, eh? Want me to help you negotiate?
say:8:1013114007:1.source_cn: 你想买这个箱子，却谈不拢价格吗……怎么样，要不要我来交...
say:8:1013114007:1.male: Haggling over this box, eh? Want me to help you negotiate?
say:8:1013114007:1.female: Haggling over this box, eh? Want me to help you negotiate?

say:10:1013114008:2.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, I've been looking for you! Any progress on the investigation?
say:10:1013114008:2.male: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, I've been looking for you! Any progress on the investigation?
say:10:1013114008:2.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, I've been looking for you! Any progress on the investigation?

say:11:1013114009:1.text: Would this box give us any of the information we need? I would like to help.
say:11:1013114009:1.source_cn: 为了取得进一步情报，最好能买下这个货箱吗？我也想出一份力。

say:13:1013114010:1.text: Magister, who are you gonna ask to negotiate for you?
say:13:1013114010:1.source_cn: 主人想让谁再交涉一番呢？
say:13:1013114010:1.male: Magister, who are you gonna ask to negotiate for you?
say:13:1013114010:1.female: Magister, who are you gonna ask to negotiate for you?

choice_prompt:14:1013114010.text: Magister, who are you gonna ask to negotiate for you?
choice_prompt:14:1013114010.source_cn: 主人想让谁再交涉一番呢？
choice_prompt:14:1013114010.male: Magister, who are you gonna ask to negotiate for you?
choice_prompt:14:1013114010.female: Magister, who are you gonna ask to negotiate for you?

say:15:1013114011:3.text: Of course! You can count on me.
say:15:1013114011:3.source_cn: 真是朴实的激将法！我承认我中招了。

say:16:1013114012:2.text: Now, good sir, regarding this box... What's the best price you can give me?
say:16:1013114012:2.source_cn: 好了。你刚才说这一箱东西多少钱？

say:17:1013114013:2.text: Mr. Valen, your friend's got great taste. This treasure box is worth this amount...
say:17:1013114013:2.source_cn: 维伦先生，您的朋友特别有眼光。这箱至宝珍玩，起码要这个数……
say:17:1013114013:2.male: Mr. Valen, your friend's got great taste. This treasure box is worth this amount...
say:17:1013114013:2.female: Mr. Valen, your friend's got great taste. This treasure box is worth this amount...

say:18:1013114014:2.text: ... Seriously? You're out of your mind!
say:18:1013114014:2.source_cn: ……你认真的吗？你这家伙的心黑透了！

narration:19:1013114015:1.text: Despite Valen's efforts, the merchant won't budge on the price, and the negotiation fails...

say:21:1013114016:3.text: I... I'll do my best. Like I do with everything.
say:21:1013114016:3.source_cn: 我……我会竭尽所能。像我做任何事一样。

say:22:1013114017:2.text: You're quite the lady. Let me tell you about the value of this special box!
say:22:1013114017:2.source_cn: 真是位英气勃勃的可爱女士。让我来给您讲讲这箱宝物的珍贵...

narration:23:1013114018:1.text: Temesia tries negotiating patiently, but was repeatedly interrupted by the merchant's slick words, and the negotiation fails...

choice:14:1:2.text: I'd rather see a Templar Knight haggle.
choice:14:1:2.source_cn: 想看看高洁的圣堂骑士讲价
choice:14:1:2.male: I'd rather see a Templar Knight haggle.
choice:14:1:2.female: I'd rather see a Templar Knight haggle.

say:24:1013114004:1.text: Magister, come now, I can't go any lower than this. Business is business.
say:24:1013114004:1.source_cn: 魔法师大人，交换就得付出代价，生意也是如此嘛。
say:24:1013114004:1.male: Magister, come now, I can't go any lower than this. Business is business.
say:24:1013114004:1.female: Magister, come now, I can't go any lower than this. Business is business.

say:26:1013114005:2.text: I misjudged you! And here I thought you were different from those other Syndicate crooks... Swindlers!
say:26:1013114005:2.source_cn: 我、我看错你们了！还以为你们跟黑金的其他坏人不一样……奸商！

choice:2:1:2.text: A whole bag? What a ripoff!
choice:2:1:2.male: A whole bag? What a ripoff!
choice:2:1:2.female: A whole bag? What a ripoff!
